title: mu_V-null subsets of the carrier are H^n-null
statement: Let n, l be natural numbers, U a subset of R^(n+l) and V = v(M, theta) a rectifiable n-varifold in U (M := V.carrier, theta := V.mult with theta > 0 on M and theta AEMeasurable for H^n restricted to M, mu := V.weight = (H^n restricted to M).withDensity (ofReal o theta), H^n := muHE[n]). If A is a subset of M with mu(A) = 0, then H^n(A) = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ n ℓ : ℕ, ∀ (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (A : Set (Amb n ℓ)), A ⊆ V.carrier → V.weight A = 0 → (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) A = 0
